_how: Share image library. Each key is a 1080x1350 background in this folder (<key>.webp), served from the stats-data branch so adding one needs no Netlify deploy. Give a recap or NFL-first item "bg": "<key>" to use it behind that share card. Text sits on the bottom ~25%, so keep faces and the gag above that. originals/ holds the full-size cleaned source. No Bills, NFL or brand logos.
